name: Gangtok, Darjeeling, East, South and West Sikkim explore
route: PICKUP from Siliguri/NJP/Bagdogra → Exploring the Charms of Pelling → Ravangla → Gang → k and Local sight seeing in Gang → Gangtok → EAST SIKKIM trip → Gang → Darjeeling

itinerary.title: PICKUP from Siliguri/NJP/Bagdogra
itinerary.desc: we provide direct pickup from RAILWAY STATION, AIRPORT and HOTELS To Ravangla (South Sikkim) Visit the Buddha Park Tallest Buddha Statue in Sikkim). Explore Ravangla town and visit the Temi Tea Garden, the only Tea Estate in Sikkim. Stay in Ravangla

itinerary.title: Exploring the Charms of Pelling (West Sikkim)
itinerary.desc: Visit the Pelling Skywalk at Chenrezig Statue, the historic Rabdentse Ruins And Rabdentse Bird Park. Overnight stay in Ravangla

itinerary.title: Ravangla to Gangtok and Local sight seeing in Gangtok
itinerary.desc: Includes 7 points in and around Gangtok Experience Ropeway of Gangtok Orchidarium Tashi view point Ganesh Tok Stay in Gangtok Bulbulay Falls (enjoy Zipline adventure) Enchey Monastery "In East Sikkim, even the clouds seem to pause and admire the view."

itinerary.title: Gangtok to EAST SIKKIM trip
itinerary.desc: Visit the magical Tsomgo lake, Experience highest ropeway in Asia (14,000 ft) Nathula pass (indo china berder) Baba Harbhajan Singh Mandir Stay in Gangtok Darjeeling feels like breathing deeper

itinerary.title: Gangtok to Darjeeling
itinerary.desc: Check into the hotel Enjoy local cafes and food Darjeeling town. Go for Toy Train Ride and evening will be for leisure. Overnight stay in Darjeeling 6 Day & TIGER HILL and OTHER LOCAL SIGHTSEEING Start your day early morning at 3 am. First point will be the Tiger Hill and then we will visit the Batasia Loop & the Tea Garden Visit Local sightseeing like Ghoom Monastery, Himalayan Zoological Park, Japanese Peace Pagoda. Darjeeling to NJP/Bagdogra/Siliguri we provide exact drop to RAIL WAY STATION, AIRPORT and HOTELS

inclusions: Accommodation in double triple and quad sharing (Standard rooms)
exclusions: Any kind of activity charges and entry fees
essentialTips: 4. Reusable Water Bottle (Xuse and throw bottles not allowed)
8. Oxygen can (for North & East Sikkim you can purchase aftor reaching Gangtok)
